senses.gloss: f. sing. a. pl. (קוקו, onomatop., cmp. קַוְקַו a. קָאקָא) [bleaters,] flock of sheep.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74">Gen. R. s. 74</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130:11">Yalk. ib. 130</cite> <he>אי הוה חמי ק׳ טבא וכ׳</he> when he saw a fine flock, he (Laban) took it for himself.
